activation_status_definitions.already_active: Source is enabled in sources.json and actively monitored.
activation_status_definitions.candidate: Source has been identified as a valid monitoring candidate. Requires no-save preview before evidence save.
activation_status_definitions.remediation: Source was tested but failed or returned insufficient content. Needs adapter remediation.
activation_status_definitions.blocked: Source is inaccessible (403, timeout, login required). Do not attempt activation without resolving the blocker.
activation_status_definitions.rejected: Source has been explicitly excluded with a documented reason. Do not add to sources.json.

priority_definitions.P0: Activate immediately — highest commercial relevance, lowest technical risk.
priority_definitions.P1: Activate soon — high commercial relevance, manageable technical risk.
priority_definitions.P2: Activate when capacity allows — useful coverage but lower urgency.
priority_definitions.P3: Niche or low-priority — activate only for specific customer segments.
priority_definitions.reject: Do not activate — documented rejection reason applies.
